Name: Clean Up George 1.6 (CP)
Author: Beleteth
Description:
Sequel to the previous Clean Up George Mods.
Removes the green stains on both Georges shirt and wheelchair, also includes the winter outfit.

I wrote this mod because both previous mods are either outdated or simply don't work for my current set up.

The original upload by jewel721 is not compatible with Content Patcher and did not work for my game.

The Content Patcher version of Alansmelons on the other hand is not only missing the newly added winter outfit, but for some reason also scrubs off Georges wrinkles completely (which I'm not a fan of).

I used no files of the previous two mod authors, but felt their efforts should still be mentioned since without them I might have never noticed the need for this mod.


Now Harvey can have one headache less, considering George's personal hygiene.
